# RubberDeck

> Unified BLE 5.0 and USB CDC control PWA and Capacitor 8 mobile application for RubberOtter and RubberOrca USB HID hardware.

## Live App & Source
- Live PWA: https://atacanymc.github.io/RubberDeck/
- Demo Video: https://youtu.be/5-odyMa4obA
- Repository: https://github.com/AtaCanYmc/RubberDeck
- Privacy Policy: https://atacanymc.github.io/RubberDeck/privacy.html

## Supported Hardware
- **RubberOtter** (ATmega32U4 + HM-10 / ESP32): 384 B max payload; keyboard, mouse, media, jiggler, haptics, quick macros.
- **RubberOrca** (ESP32-S3): 1024 B max payload; all RubberOtter features plus 16 NVS macros (`m0..m15`), `layout us|tr_q`, `ble name`, `ble passkey`.

## Protocol & Transports
- RubberOtter v1 framed wire protocol (`STX 0x02`, `VER 0x01`, `SEQ`, `LEN`, `PAYLOAD`, `XOR`, `ETX 0x03`) with 6-byte ACK.
- Transports: Web Bluetooth (`0000ffe0`/`0000ffe1`), Web Serial (USB CDC 115200 baud), Capacitor BLE (iOS/Android), and MockTransport.
- Offline-first via `vite-plugin-pwa` (Workbox); zero backend servers.
